item.avatarbending.avatar_spirit.tooltip: The spirit of the Avatar, reborn in you.
Use it to master all four elements!
element.avatarbending.air.desc: Speed and freedom. Blow enemies away. No fall damage!
element.avatarbending.water.desc: Whips, ice and healing. Stronger in water and rain!
element.avatarbending.earth.desc: Boulders, walls and earthquakes. Mine faster!
element.avatarbending.fire.desc: Fireballs, jets and lightning. Immune to fire!
ability.avatarbending.air_blast.desc: A gust that flies through mobs, flinging them away.
ability.avatarbending.air_barrage.desc: Five gusts in a wide fan. Great for crowds.
ability.avatarbending.air_blade.desc: A crescent of razor wind that slices through every mob in a line.
ability.avatarbending.air_leap.desc: Launch yourself high into the sky and glide back down.
ability.avatarbending.air_scooter.desc: Ride a spinning ball of air: super speed and high jumps for 8 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.wind_shield.desc: A spinning dome of wind turns away arrows and keeps mobs back for 10 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.vacuum.desc: Suck every mob into one point, then smash them together in a burst of air.
ability.avatarbending.air_sphere.desc: A 360° shockwave that throws everything away and reflects arrows.
ability.avatarbending.tornado.desc: Summon a roaring tornado that sucks mobs up into the sky.
ability.avatarbending.air_cannon.desc: Compress the wind, then fire a sonic blast that pierces everything in a 40-block line.
ability.avatarbending.water_whip.desc: A fast spiraling whip of water. 50% stronger in water or rain.
ability.avatarbending.ice_shards.desc: Seven razor-sharp ice shards in a wide spray.
ability.avatarbending.ice_wave.desc: Ice spikes race along the ground and freeze mobs solid in an ice prison.
ability.avatarbending.glacier_bomb.desc: Hurl a water orb that explodes into ice and freezes everything nearby.
ability.avatarbending.healing_waters.des: Glowing water heals you, nearby players and your pets, and cures poison.
ability.avatarbending.water_spout.desc: Ride a tall column of water and hover above the battlefield. Sneak to go down.
ability.avatarbending.octopus_form.desc: Eight water tentacles lash nearby mobs and block projectiles for 10 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.tidal_wave.desc: A huge wave sweeps mobs away and puts out fires.
ability.avatarbending.bloodbending.desc: Seize every creature nearby, lift them up and slam them down. Stronger under a full moon.
ability.avatarbending.maelstrom.desc: A giant whirlpool drags mobs in, then erupts in a geyser.
ability.avatarbending.boulder_toss.desc: Rip a boulder out of the ground and hurl it where you aim.
ability.avatarbending.rock_barrage.desc: Six rocks orbit you, then fire one after another at your target.
ability.avatarbending.earth_spikes.desc: A line of rock spikes erupts from the ground and launches mobs.
ability.avatarbending.earth_wall.desc: Raise a wall of rock to block attacks. It sinks back after 10 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.earth_pillar.desc: A pillar of rock shoots up under your feet and launches you.
ability.avatarbending.metal_cables.desc: Fire a steel cable: hook a block to zip to it, or hook a mob to yank it to you.
ability.avatarbending.earth_armor.desc: Wrap yourself in rock: Resistance II and extra hearts for 30 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.seismic_slam.desc: Earthquake! Use it in the air to dive down for an even bigger quake.
ability.avatarbending.lavabending.desc: Hurl a stream of molten lava bombs that burn where they land.
ability.avatarbending.fissure.desc: Tear the ground open under your enemies, then slam it shut. The ground always closes back.
ability.avatarbending.fire_blast.desc: A blast of fire that sets mobs ablaze. Never burns blocks.
ability.avatarbending.fire_whip.desc: A long whip of fire lashes everything in a wide arc in front of you.
ability.avatarbending.fire_jet.desc: Rocket where you look on jets of flame and steer as you fly. Burns mobs you pass.
ability.avatarbending.inferno_ring.desc: An expanding ring of fire burns everything around you.
ability.avatarbending.dragon_breath.desc: Breathe a roaring cone of blue fire for 2 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.fire_dragon.desc: Unleash a dragon of fire that hunts the nearest enemy and explodes.
ability.avatarbending.combustion.desc: Focus your third eye and fire an explosive beam. No block damage.
ability.avatarbending.lightning.desc: Charge up, then strike with lightning that chains to 3 more enemies. Stronger in storms!
ability.avatarbending.firestorm.desc: Burning meteors rain from the sky onto the area you aim at for 4 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.elemental_storm.de: All four elements orbit you and blast everything nearby for 5 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.energybending.desc: Grab a target's spirit. Huge damage, and enemy benders lose their bending for 30s.
ability.avatarbending.meteor_strike.desc: Pull a flaming meteor out of the sky onto your target. No block damage.
ability.avatarbending.elemental_beam.des: Charge all four elements, then fire a beam that pierces everything for 2 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.fire_tornado.desc: A blazing tornado that sucks mobs into its burning core.
ability.avatarbending.blizzard.desc: A howling snowstorm slows everything inside, then freezes it solid.
ability.avatarbending.volcano.desc: Raise an erupting volcano that rains lava bombs. It sinks back when the eruption ends.
ability.avatarbending.spirit_form.desc: Leave your body as a spirit: fly, turn invisible and shrug off damage for 8 seconds.
ability.avatarbending.raavas_light.desc: Fully heal and cleanse yourself and allies. Burns the undead and drives back monsters.
ability.avatarbending.avatars_wrath.desc: Avatar State only. Rise up and unleash every element, lightning and a final cataclysm.
hud.avatarbending.choose_hint: Press %s to choose your bending element!
screen.avatarbending.choose.title: Choose Your Element
screen.avatarbending.choose.subtitle: Master one element now. Craft the Avatar Spirit later to master them all.

screen.avatarbending.menu.become_avatar: Become the Avatar to master all four elements!

screen.avatarbending.menu.controls: Click a spell to select it. [%s] Bend · [%s] Next spell · [%s] Switch element · [%s] Avatar State
message.avatarbending.controls: Press R to bend, G for the next spell and K for your bending scroll.
message.avatarbending.already_chosen: You already chose your element. Only the Avatar can bend more than one.
message.avatarbending.only_avatar_switch: Only the Avatar can switch elements.
message.avatarbending.not_avatar: Only the Avatar can enter the Avatar State.
message.avatarbending.avatar_state_coold: The Avatar State needs %s more seconds.
message.avatarbending.choose_first: Choose your first element before you become the Avatar.
message.avatarbending.became_avatar: You are the Avatar! Press V to switch elements and B to enter the Avatar State.
message.avatarbending.need_ground: You need solid ground under your feet.
message.avatarbending.suppressed: Your bending is blocked for %s seconds!
message.avatarbending.energybent: %s took away your bending for 30 seconds!
title.avatarbending.avatar_state.sub: Every past Avatar is with you
